# Review - PR 289 @ b2547508db659ec5c3742cbf6792cad83ae455c5

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 48d2e95ea5c9b01e6974dc784e3a4300499ffccc. Purely additive change of 514 lines over four files (merge base 55a94e7850c04dc9979ce840e889a07c87333f29, base branch `main`): one new Lean module identifying the separated image of the polynomial combining map, its aggregate import, a statement-integrity audit, and two new blueprint nodes.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/CombinedPolynomialImage.lean:128 - `combinePoly_injective` re-declares the existing `MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly_injective` of MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/PairCompletion.lean:61 (same namespace, statement identical up to the binder name), and MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean imports both modules (line 46 and, through Combining/Apply.lean, line 81), so the qualified name denotes whichever module comes first in the import order; I confirmed by an environment query that in a file importing this module first the name resolves to CombinedPolynomialImage and the PairCompletion declaration is no longer reachable under that name. Reuse the main-branch theorem instead of a second copy - for example move it to Combining/Defs.lean, which both modules already import - and drop the duplicate from the audit's declaration list in audits/2026-09-06_combined-polynomial-image.md:433.
- [ ] F2 (prose; changes) blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:1631 - `\lean{MIPStarRE.QPBT.combinePoly_injective}` in `lem:combine-map-separated-image` names a declaration that `lem:qld-combined-pair-completion` already claims with `\leanok` at blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:3200, so two nodes assert ownership of one Lean name and the new node's `\leanok` does not correspond to a declaration this PR introduces. Remove that `\lean` line from the new node and, if the injectivity fact is needed there, cite the existing node through `\uses{lem:qld-combined-pair-completion}`.

## Review

Scope checked: the full main-relative diff (MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean, MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/CombinedPolynomialImage.lean, audits/2026-09-06_combined-polynomial-image.md, blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex), read in full, plus the supporting declarations the new module builds on.

Faithfulness. The paper defines the combining map at references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:976-983 as `combine_{f,g}(x,z,alpha,beta) = alpha f(x) + beta g(z)` with `f,g` in `ideg_{d,m}` and `combine_{f,g}` in `ideg_{d,2m+2}`, and fixes the separated locus `G` at lines 1326-1345 (`g = alpha g_1 + beta g_2` with `g_1` depending only on `x` and `g_2` only on `z`), reindexed by pairs at `eq:qld-sgg-completeness`. `IsSeparatedCombined` encodes exactly that: vanishing of every combining coefficient outside the two standard basis exponents, plus containment of each remaining coefficient's variable set in its own point block. `recoverCombinedPoly` is `killCompl` applied to `splitCombinedPoly`, i.e. substitute the `r`-th standard basis vector for `(alpha, beta)` and zero the other block, matching the blueprint prose. The `1 <= d` hypothesis appears only where the paper needs it (the two fresh linear coordinates have degree one, so the forward degree bound genuinely fails at `d = 0`); it is the existing `AdmissibleParams.hd` boundary condition, not proof debt, and the recovery and uniqueness directions are correctly stated without it. No bridge, residual, package, witness or obligation hypothesis is introduced, and nothing in the diff weakens or restates an existing declaration; the quantitative mass bound of `lem:qld-4-7` is explicitly disclaimed in the module docstring, the audit and both blueprint nodes.

Prior findings. The earlier marked review at head 4cd4bc1c raised six unresolved items; all six are addressed at this head: the audit now carries YAML front matter with title, date, purpose, status, track, kind, issue and pr (F1); it no longer describes `combinePoly_mem_polyFunc` as admitted and instead records that both routes are complete proofs (F2); the definition node now states separation unrestrictedly over an arbitrary commutative semiring and introduces the bounded separated locus as its intersection with the individual-degree class (F3); the lemma node states the all-`d` recovery and uniqueness results and confines `d >= 1` to the forward degree bound and the bijection (F4); `combinedBlockVar_injective` has moved from the definition node into the new lemma node (F5); and the proof `\uses` now lists `def:ld-combining-map`, `lem:ld-combining-split` and `lem:ld-combining-exact-linearity`, all of which resolve (ch13_qpbt_test.tex:335, :369, :627), as do the other cited labels (F6).

Reuse and integrity. The module builds on existing declarations rather than re-proving them: `combinePolyTuple`, `splitCombinedPoly`, `combinedCoef`, `combinePolyTuple_combinedCoef_iff`, `combinedCoef_combinePolyTuple(_eq_zero)`, `combinedCoef_mem_polyFunc` and `combinePolyTuple_mem_polyFunc` from Combining/DirectLowDegree/Transport/Combining, with Mathlib's `exists_rename_eq_of_vars_subset_range` and `killCompl_rename_app` for the support argument. The one exception is F1. Related, and not a merge blocker on its own: `recoverCombinedPoly` covers the same substitution as the existing `recoverCombinedPair` (MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/PairCompletion.lean:35, with its own round-trip lemma and blueprint node `def:qld-pair-restriction-completion`), so the same consolidation that resolves F1 is worth extending to the two recovery maps. A scan of the other fifteen new public names found no further collision. The new file has no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, unsafe cast, placeholder tactic or debug command, is 272 lines with no line over 100 characters, and follows the required file structure (imports, module docstring with a References section, namespace, declarations) with a docstring on every public declaration.

Verification run: `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/CombinedPolynomialImage.lean` and `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT.lean` both completed with no diagnostics in the PR worktree, whose HEAD equals the published head; the name-resolution claim in F1 was checked with a `getModuleIdxFor?` query in a file importing both modules. Exact-head CI: `local-ci/summary` success, with build, blueprint-render, blueprint-sync, paper-gaps, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion and statement-origin all success.

Not checked: I did not run a full `lake build` or the blueprint HTML render myself (I relied on the exact-head `local-ci/build` and `local-ci/blueprint-render` statuses), did not re-verify the axiom closures listed in the audit beyond the absence of proof holes and the green proof-debt step, and did not review the quantitative estimates of `lem:qld-4-7`, which this diff does not touch.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
